steps.title: Clean the vise and set the parallels
steps.caption: Blow out the 6 in vise and wipe the jaws, then set 1 in parallels.

steps.title: Load the part
steps.caption: Set the part in the 6 in vise, pocket side up, on 1 in parallels.

steps.title: Seat it and tighten the vise
steps.caption: Close the jaw until it touches, tap the part down, then tighten the handle.

steps.title: Check the parallels are pinched
steps.caption: Try each parallel with a fingertip: neither should move.

steps.title: Find X and Y
steps.caption: Set G54 X at the centre of the stock's length and Y at the centre of its width.

steps.title: Set Z
steps.caption: Set G54 Z at top of the faced stock.

steps.title: Load the tools
steps.caption: Load the 2 in face mill, the 1/2 in end mill, the 3/8 in end mill, the 2.5 mm drill, the 6 mm drill into the carousel.

steps.title: Close the door and start the cycle
steps.caption: Close the door, check the program is Op 10: pocket side, and press Cycle Start.

steps.title: Face datum A flat (flatness 0.2) and to height
steps.caption: Face datum A flat (flatness 0.2) and to height, with the 2 in face mill.

steps.title: Profile the body and the four mounting ears to the model outline
steps.caption: Profile the body and the four mounting ears to the model outline, with the 1/2 in end mill.

steps.title: Rough and finish the pocket 17 mm deep (profile 1.2 to A B C)
steps.caption: Rough and finish the pocket 17 mm deep (profile 1.2 to A B C), with the 3/8 in end mill.

steps.title: Drill 8X Ø2.5 ±0.15 from the pocket floor into the cross bores (note 4)
steps.caption: Drill 8X Ø2.5 ±0.15 from the pocket floor into the cross bores (note 4), with the 2.5 mm drill.

steps.title: Drill 4X Ø6 ±0.15 through the mounting ears
steps.caption: Drill 4X Ø6 ±0.15 through the mounting ears, with the 6 mm drill.

steps.title: Blow off the chips and unload
steps.caption: Open the door, blow the chips off, loosen the vise and lift the part out.

steps.title: Clean the vise and set the parallels
steps.caption: Blow out the 6 in vise and wipe the jaws, then set 1 in parallels.

steps.title: Load the part
steps.caption: Set the part in the 6 in vise, scalloped side up, on 1 in parallels.

steps.title: Seat it and tighten the vise
steps.caption: Close the jaw until it touches, tap the part down, then tighten the handle.

steps.title: Check the parallels are pinched
steps.caption: Try each parallel with a fingertip: neither should move.

steps.title: Find X and Y
steps.caption: Set G54 X at the ear holes (probe) and Y at the ear holes (probe).

steps.title: Set Z
steps.caption: Set G54 Z at datum A on the parallels, plus 31 mm.

steps.title: Load the tools
steps.caption: Load the 1/4 in ball end mill, the 1/4 in end mill, the 3.5 mm reamer, the M3 tap into the carousel.

steps.title: Close the door and start the cycle
steps.caption: Close the door, check the program is Op 20: scalloped side, and press Cycle Start.

steps.title: Face to the 31 mm overall height
steps.caption: Face to the 31 mm overall height, with the 2 in face mill.

steps.title: Rough and finish the four Ø16 humps and the Ø25 hollows between them
steps.caption: Rough and finish the four Ø16 humps and the Ø25 hollows between them, with the 1/4 in ball end mill.

steps.title: Mill the oval boss and the three coplanar pads (datum D)
steps.caption: Mill the oval boss and the three coplanar pads (datum D), with the 1/4 in end mill.

steps.title: Drill and ream 3X Ø3.5 G6 to D B C
steps.caption: Drill and ream 3X Ø3.5 G6 to D B C, with the 3.5 mm reamer.

steps.title: Drill Ø2.5 and tap 6X M3x0.5-6g
steps.caption: Drill Ø2.5 and tap 6X M3x0.5-6g, with the M3 tap.

steps.title: Counterbore the ears Ø10 and spot Ø18
steps.caption: Counterbore the ears Ø10 and spot Ø18, with the 3/8 in end mill.

steps.title: Blow off the chips and unload
steps.caption: Open the door, blow the chips off, loosen the vise and lift the part out.

steps.title: Clean the vise and set the parallels
steps.caption: Blow out the 6 in vise and wipe the jaws, then set 1 in parallels.

steps.title: Load the part
steps.caption: Set the part in the 6 in vise, on its F65 side, on 1 in parallels.

steps.title: Seat it and tighten the vise
steps.caption: Close the jaw until it touches, tap the part down, then tighten the handle.

steps.title: Check the parallels are pinched
steps.caption: Try each parallel with a fingertip: neither should move.

steps.title: Find X and Y
steps.caption: Set G54 X at the left end (probe) and Y at datum A (probe).

steps.title: Set Z
steps.caption: Set G54 Z at top of the side face.

steps.title: Load the tools
steps.caption: Load the 7 mm drill into the carousel.

steps.title: Close the door and start the cycle
steps.caption: Close the door, check the program is Op 30: first long side (F65), and press Cycle Start.

steps.title: Drill 4X Ø7 ±0.25 through the humps
steps.caption: Drill 4X Ø7 ±0.25 through the humps, with the 7 mm drill.

steps.title: Counterbore 4X Ø10 ±0.25, 10 ±0.2 deep
steps.caption: Counterbore 4X Ø10 ±0.25, 10 ±0.2 deep, with the 3/8 in end mill.

steps.title: Blow off the chips and unload
steps.caption: Open the door, blow the chips off, loosen the vise and lift the part out.

steps.title: Clean the vise and set the parallels
steps.caption: Blow out the 6 in vise and wipe the jaws, then set 1 in parallels.

steps.title: Load the part
steps.caption: Set the part in the 6 in vise, on its F81 side, on 1 in parallels.

steps.title: Seat it and tighten the vise
steps.caption: Close the jaw until it touches, tap the part down, then tighten the handle.

steps.title: Check the parallels are pinched
steps.caption: Try each parallel with a fingertip: neither should move.

steps.title: Find X and Y
steps.caption: Set G54 X at a Ø7 bore (probe) and Y at datum A (probe).

steps.title: Set Z
steps.caption: Set G54 Z at top of the side face.

steps.title: Close the door and start the cycle
steps.caption: Close the door, check the program is Op 40: second long side (F81), and press Cycle Start.

steps.title: Counterbore 4X Ø10 ±0.25, 10 ±0.2 deep, coaxial with the bores
steps.caption: Counterbore 4X Ø10 ±0.25, 10 ±0.2 deep, coaxial with the bores, with the 3/8 in end mill.

steps.title: Blow off the chips and unload
steps.caption: Open the door, blow the chips off, loosen the vise and lift the part out.

steps.title: Clean the vise and set the stop
steps.caption: Blow out the 6 in vise and wipe the jaws and its floor, then set the stop.

steps.title: Load the part
steps.caption: Set the part in the 6 in vise, standing on one end, on the vise floor and a stop.

steps.title: Seat it and tighten the vise
steps.caption: Close the jaw until it touches, tap the part down, then tighten the handle.

steps.title: Check it's square
steps.caption: Sweep the indicator up its side: the needle should stay put.

steps.title: Find X and Y
steps.caption: Set G54 X at the side (probe) and Y at datum A (probe).

steps.title: Set Z
steps.caption: Set G54 Z at top of the end.

steps.title: Load the tools
steps.caption: Load the 5.5 mm drill into the carousel.

steps.title: Close the door and start the cycle
steps.caption: Close the door, check the program is Op 50: first end, and press Cycle Start.

steps.title: Peck-drill both Ø5.5 ±0.2 holes from this end, 35 ±1 and 27.5 ±1 deep
steps.caption: Peck-drill both Ø5.5 ±0.2 holes from this end, 35 ±1 and 27.5 ±1 deep, with the 5.5 mm drill.

steps.title: Blow off the chips and unload
steps.caption: Open the door, blow the chips off, loosen the vise and lift the part out.

steps.title: Deburr every edge: scrape off the sharp slivers of metal (burrs) the cutters leave on the edges
steps.caption: Deburr every edge: scrape off the sharp slivers of metal (burrs) the cutters leave on the edges, with a hooked blade drawn along each one, so the part is safe to handle. Break the sharp corners of the pocket and the cross holes.

steps.title: Check the pocket depth
steps.caption: Check the pocket depth, the 31 mm height, the Ø3.5 G6 pins with gauge pins, the M3 threads with a go/no-go gauge, and the Ø7 bores.
